title: Not as advertised
text: The box arrived quickly and in good condition. The box says where it’s from so my husband knows I got more books. The surprise was a cheap sucker, which sums up what I feel. I’m a sucker for subscribing for this box. It claims you will receive 2 hardcover books, yet as you can see from my photo I got a paperback. That book mentions Netflix, which I do not have nor want. Sadly I’m not too enthusiastic about what arrived. I shall try another month with hope it gets better.
label: neutral
